provider_eligibility_requirement: Two completed public-library website/CMS projects and three genuine references, including a qualified named substantive U.S. partner if any
notes: Working internal evidence matrix; NOT an actual vendor submission or assertion that Custom/Roadmap obligations will be fulfilled. No live library patron data or client logos assumed.

response_rows.requirement: Patron navigation, search and six journeys
response_rows.description_evidence: Historical v4 checkpoint #2216 records six patron journeys and searchable services; original ZIP bytes not yet recovered.
response_rows.additional_cost_or_dependency: Original v4 byte recovery, screen-reader and current mobile QA; YVL approval

response_rows.requirement: All 15 libraries, locations and Bookmobile
response_rows.description_evidence: Historical v4 records 15 branch names including Harrah; does not prove current hours or real bookmobile maps.
response_rows.additional_cost_or_dependency: YVL-authorized location feeds, accessible text alternative and staff editing

response_rows.requirement: Approved YVL brand identity and website style guide
response_rows.description_evidence: Independent v4 prototype was not an approved YVL design.
response_rows.additional_cost_or_dependency: Approved assets/style guide from YVL and documented review cycles

response_rows.requirement: WordPress CMS and separate content-model plugin
response_rows.description_evidence: Historical v4 checkpoint records theme plus independent service/branch/outreach plugin; no original source or WordPress staging currently verified.
response_rows.additional_cost_or_dependency: Original ZIPs, plugin licensing, WordPress sandbox and role/revision QA

response_rows.requirement: Staff roles, approval, revisions, scheduling and rollback
response_rows.description_evidence: No tested real WordPress operator/admin environment or rollback evidence.

response_rows.requirement: Hosted staging and safe production deployment
response_rows.description_evidence: No production tenancy or U.S.-located YVL-specific staging proven.

response_rows.requirement: 150–200 page content inventory, migration and redirects
response_rows.description_evidence: Historical engineering ZIP described WXR inventory tool with duplication/slugs/draft/external links; not executed against YVL records.

response_rows.requirement: Staff-accessible PDF remediation and validation

response_rows.requirement: Mobile-friendly, supported language translation

response_rows.requirement: WCAG 2.2 AA manual/automated accessibility verification
